items.item_text: Active Registered Nurse license in the State of California
Basic Life Support (BLS) from the American Heart Association
Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) from the American Heart Association
Bachelors Of Science in Nursing (BSN) or related field
1-3 years of Surgical service line nursing experience in an acute care hospital required.
Assists in selection, training, and evaluation of subordinates and initiates personnel actions in accordance with Human Resources policy and organizational philosophy
Participates in development and maintenance of department policies and protocols. Understands, communicates and enforces hospital policies and regulatory requirements
Participates in the orientation of personnel. Provides educational resources and serves as the resource person. Mentors staff and plans and implement shift report
Assists management in the development of the department operating budget and maintaining necessary controls to assure compliance with budgeted expenses, resources and staff productivity

Supervises the day to day activity of the department, ensuring all policies and procedures are adhered to, patient concerns are addressed, phones are answered in a timely manner and all areas are staffed appropriately
